svg.title: GenAI Eval Engine — full architecture v3
svg.desc: Layered architecture showing all Redis interactions explicitly: rate limiting, JWT blacklist, score cache, and Celery broker/backend
svg.text: Middleware — last registered runs first: RateLimit → Logging

g.text: decode JWT → check Redis blacklist → fetch user

svg.text: Routes — app/api/routes/ — thin HTTP layer, no business logic
Background worker — separate process from FastAPI
Repository — app/repositories/ — all SQL lives here, never in services or routes

g.text: ① rate limit counters ② JWT blacklist
③ score cache ④ Celery broker + backend
